// diagnostic

E0757

A library effect's `#FX(…)` list denies an effect, or a function row denies a library effect by name

What

A library effect's `#FX(…)` list denies an effect, or a function row denies a library effect by name

Why

The list above a library effect names the kernel effects it relies on, and a denial checks what a body really reaches, which is kernel effects

Fix

List kernel effects above the library effect, and deny the kernel effects it relies on instead of its name

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0757: tests/ui/effects/library_effect_list_denial_is_e0757.stderr.

Error [jet.LibraryEffectNotKernel]: The `#FX(…)` above the library effect `Query` denies `FS`
  --> tests/ui/effects/library_effect_list_denial_is_e0757.jet:1:10
    |
  1 | #FX(Net, !FS)
    |          ^^^
 Why: The list above a library effect names the kernel effects it relies on, so it holds no `!` entries
 Fix: Remove `!FS`; a caller that must not use `FS` writes `-[!FS]>` itself
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0757
